    {a : α} {k : ℕ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (h : multiplicity (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) P = k) :
    ∃ g : Polynomial α,
      P = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ k * g ∧ Polynomial.eval a g ≠ 0 := by
  sorry

theorem Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_multiplicity
  (p : Polynomial R) (a : R) :
  Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p =
    if p = 0 then 0 else multiplicity (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p

-- this theorem might be useful in the proof of the problem
theorem Polynomial.exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd
  (p : Polynomial R) (hp : p ≠ 0) (a : R) :
  ∃ q, p = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) ^ Polynomial.rootMultiplicity a p * q
    ∧ ¬ Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ q

theorem Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot :
  Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a ∣ p ↔ p.IsRoot a

theorem Polynomial.IsRoot.def :
